name: Rosewood Mayakoba
positioning: Riviera Maya resort set between the tropical jungle and the Caribbean Sea, with villas and suites by lagoon, beach and jungle
best_for: Travelers choosing between a lagoon-view suite and a suite on the sand
Golfers and divers wanting El Camaleon and the barrier reef close by
Families, with kids' menus, special events and activities

facts.text: The resort sits between the tropical jungle and the Caribbean Sea in the Riviera Maya.
Accommodation is in villas and suites set by the lagoon, the beach and the jungle.
Oceanview Suites are two-story and three-story units on the beachside area of the resort.
Agave Azul is a Northern Baja California seafood restaurant with Asian influences.
Punta Bonita serves Mexican flavors with panoramic views of the Caribbean.
Casa Del Lago serves tropical breakfast in the traditional style of Central Mexico.
Pan Dulce is a bakery in the El Pueblito village square drawing on panaderia traditions.
La Fondita is an indoor-outdoor restaurant inspired by Mexico City's neighborhood cantinas.
Zapote Bar is a cocktail bar serving food made with local ingredients.
The resort offers kids' menus, special events and activities for families.

highlights.text: Lagoon Suites overlook Mayakoba's winding lagoons and mangrove jungle.
La Ceiba Garden & Kitchen serves Mayan-inspired flavors at a communal table under a Ceiba tree.
Beachfront Suites are located directly on the sand, steps from the ocean, with sunset views.
The Mayakoba Dive & Water Sports Center offers experiences on the Caribbean Sea and its barrier reef.
The El Camaleon golf course runs through Mayakoba from tropical jungle to the oceanfront.

considerations.text: Lagoon Suites face the lagoons and mangrove jungle; the Beachfront Suites are the ones directly on the sand.
WhataHotel notes a remote location that requires resort transfers.
